summary: Iteration 12: tested both backend and frontend for the hub redesign, the renames, timed-only Tower, T Mines floors, the Vortex first-spin loophole, Chicken modes and the nest prize, Profile per-game stats, silent auto-refresh, the admin nested-garbage 400, and the lag regression. Backend: new test_iter12.py passed 13/13. Config shows stack challenges sprint 15/25s/5x, pro 25/40s/10x, master 45/60s/20x and mp_enabled=false. Vortex lose counts are earth [3,3,4,4,5], water [4,5,5,6,7], fire [5,6,7,8,9], so first-spin survival is 0.75 / 0.6667 / 0.5833. Chicken has modes medium/hard/hardcore labelled Sprint/Pro/Master. Stack start with mode endless and no challenge gives 400 'Pick a timed challenge'; with challenge_id it is forced to timed (15 blocks in 25s). In 40 fire first spins via the API, 14 were losses (35%, expected ~42%), and every landing matched the HMAC provably-fair recomputation and the lose_slots. With 'easy', chicken start falls back to medium. /stats/by-game returns all fields, the math is consistent (played=won+lost, net=earned-wagered, loss=max(0,-net)), labels are tower='T Mines', stack='Tower', fixed='Stopwatch', and counts match the games collection. A garbage vortex theme or chicken mode gives 400, and the config was restored. The timed sprint win with 16 perfect taps pays 5x (100). Frontend (390/430 mobile, 1920 desktop): The hub has 6 cards in a 2-column grid (stopwatch and vortex span 2 columns) with neon borders. Titles are T Mines -> /games/tower and Tower -> /games/stack. The Ken Burns animation runs (the transform changes over time), the sweep and 7 sparks are present, all images load, .font-display computes to 'Lilita One' and the font is loaded, and there is no fairness link or text. Hub FPS is 60. Silent refresh works: after a mongo balance change to 7777, the header showed 7,777 in ~8s without a reload. Tower page: title 'Tower', no Endless or Versus tabs, the challenge cards show the correct values, and a sprint run works (timer 24.9s counting down, Space taps, 'Challenge failed' result with height 2). T Mines: header OK, and 7 floors with multiplier labels are visible at both 390 and 430 when idle and about 6 during play. Start, tile 0-0 and cash out at 25.40 work. Chicken: no easy button, Sprint/Pro/Master with Sprint selected by default, 22 lane chips 1.1x..16.15x, and an animated nest badge (323.00 = 20 x 16.15, 'now' goes 0.00 -> 22.00 after a step). Collect works. Vortex fire UI: the first spin lost ('Vortex broke'). Stopwatch: canvas renders during play, stop works, 61fps. Aviator: canvas renders, multiplier rose to 1.41x. Profile: profile-by-game is a sibling after the red banner (not inside it) and lists 7 games, 60fps. Admin: typed 1234 into Min Deposit, and after 10.5s the value and focus were kept while stats/withdrawals/deposits/audit-logs were re-fetched in the background. No page errors anywhere.

minor.issue: mp_enabled is still True in the code defaults (games_extra.py line 77). Only the live DB was migrated to false, so a fresh DB or deployment would re-enable versus rooms and the bot room loop (_ensure_open_rooms) even though the UI has no Versus tab.
ChickenStartReq.mode still defaults to 'easy' (a mode that no longer exists). It falls back to medium, which works, but the default should be 'medium'.

ui_bugs.issue: The user asked for 'all multipliers on screen', but at 390px the strip is a horizontal scroller (scrollWidth 1285 vs clientWidth 358), so only ~6 of 22 lanes are visible. It also doesn't auto-scroll to the current or next lane as the chicken advances. Use flex-wrap (a grid of chips) or scrollIntoView on the 'next' chip.

After Start/GO the page scrolls so the sticky navbar covers the top of chicken-road. The golden nest badge (absolute top-3 right-3) with the live 'now' cash-out value sits under the header and can't be seen during play at 390x844 (seen in the screenshot after step 1).

issues: 'earned' is shown with toFixed(0) (2483, 367), while net is shown with 2 decimals (+422.93, -313.00). The numbers look inconsistent; use the same precision.
The floor multiplier labels are small grey text on a dark background (low contrast) but fully visible. During play the active floor sits mid-canvas, with ~170px of empty space below it.
After a run ends, the page scroll leaves the top of the result card (and the canvas) under the sticky header.
Still open from iteration 11: the header content (logo at x~340 and Sign out) is narrower and offset from the body container (x~288).

action_items: Chicken: show all lane multipliers without horizontal scrolling (wrap them into a grid), or at least auto-scroll the strip to the next lane.
Chicken: keep the golden nest badge visible during play on mobile. Avoid scrolling the road under the sticky header, or move the badge below the canvas or into the action panel.
Set EXTRA_DEFAULTS stack_config.mp_enabled = False and ChickenStartReq.mode default to 'medium'.
Optional cleanup: remove the dead endless/versus code in TowerStack.js (hidden TABS div, loadRooms, the endless-rules block, the liveMult endless HUD) and the endless branch in stack_finish.
Optional: use the same precision for 'earned' on the Profile game cards.
critical_code_review_comments: games_extra.py is 1031 lines (over the 700-line limit). Split it into vortex/chicken/stack/fair modules.
TowerStack.js still renders a hidden TABS div and keeps the endless/versus branches (the tab state can only be 'timed'). This is dead code.
The Navbar wallet poll runs every 8s plus on focus, and calls /wallet on each route change. That is fine, but the focus and interval refetches can overlap; consider debouncing.
Admin silent refresh correctly skips /admin/config and /admin/users, so edits and search are kept (verified).
